ALLIED HEALTH PROFESSIONS ACT 2016

ALLIED HEALTH PROFESSIONS REGULATIONS (FEES) 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 45(2)(b) of the

Allied Health Professions Act 2016 [Act 774], the Council, with the approval of the

Minister, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Allied Health Professions

Regulations (Fees) 2020.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 July 2020.

Fees

2. The fees payable to the Council in respect of the matters specified in column (1) of

the Schedule shall be as prescribed in column (2).

Waiver

3. The Council may reduce or waive, the amount of fees prescribed in these

Regulations for an allied health practitioner in the public services.
